title: Concerning the Five Wonders that the Light Mind shall display in the Elect
teaching_text:
Once again the apostle speaks: The Light Mind shall enact five light signs in the elect.

The first sign is the wisdom that the elect shall preach and proclaim in all its shapes and forms and manners.

The second is the faith; since after his preaching of the wisdom that he proclaims, the others who hear it believe it.

The third is [...] in his preaching [...] peace of heart for the assembly of his brethren [...]

The fourth is love, for he shall love wisdom [...] the brothers and sisters who are seated [before] him.

The fifth is the fear of legal excommunication that shall exclude him amongst these who did not receive the hope of God. Also other iniquitous people who shall be found in the church; it excludes them with a legal excommunication, on account of their foolishness.

The Light Mind puts these five signs in the new man, [whom he has] purified, cleansed, supported and chosen [...]

Blessed is every one [...] the Mind and is diligent in his wisdom [...]

⟨p.258⟩ The [other] one: These five signs will be established in him and perfected in him, so that [he] will become a faultless vessel and a pearl without price for ever at all!
gardner_synopsis: There are five qualities proclaimed and enacted by the elect person who is indwelt by the Light Mind, and who has thus become a new man.
